title: NEXUS device status (plain text)
description: The MQTT status payload is bare text, not JSON: online (retained birth) or offline (retained last will). The validator decodes the bytes as UTF-8, applies String.trim() semantics (strip characters up to U+0020 at both ends) and checks the result against this schema as a JSON string. The comparison is CASE-SENSITIVE exactly like DeviceStatusMessageHandler. The production payload is never wrapped, enveloped or versioned.
x-nexus-rules: preprocessing: UTF-8 decode, then trim characters <= U+0020 from both ends (java.lang.String.trim)
no contractVersion and no JSON envelope; status always resolves to legacy-v1 semantics
